simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גֶּזֶר (H1506) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גֶּזֶר (gezer) means something cut off ; a portion First listed occurrence: Gen 15 17.

definitions.full: H1506. gezer I. [ גֶּ֫זֶר ] noun [masculine] part , only plural הַגְּזָרִים Gen 15:17 of halves of animals; גְּזָרִים Psa 136:13 of divided portions of Red Sea.
